capabilities: Import and run local .ops code modules
Organize modules in a grid card container
Isolate module code and configuration from notes
extras: Warns that third-party .ops modules are not vetted and users assume the security risk.
motivation: The author built it to fill gaps around micro-widget development, startup performance, and multi-device configuration conflicts.
problem: Users needing small local widgets must enable many plugins or embed JavaScript in notes, causing startup lag and sync conflicts.

relations.evidence: Perform script-level lifecycle mounting via pluto.third.templater
Unlock no-code advanced data rendering output via pluto.third.dva

summary: Lightweight module manager that imports, runs, and organizes local .ops code modules in sandboxed containers.
